s.note: Ham can't believe Smalls has never had one
s.how: Toast 16 big marshmallows over a flame until blistered and molten. Squash each between 2 digestive biscuits with a square of milk chocolate, 32 biscuits and 100g chocolate in total, so it melts. Eat them by the handful.

s.note: a sandlot game in the summer heat
s.how: Spread 400g raw peanuts in the shell on a tray and roast at 180C for 15 minutes. Melt 30g butter with 3 tbsp honey, 1 tsp sea salt and half a tsp smoked paprika. Toss the hot peanuts through the glaze, spread back on the tray and roast 6 minutes more until sticky. Cool so the glaze sets, then divide into four paper bags with a bowl for the shells.

m.note: the night game under the fireworks
m.how: Cook 2 sliced onions slowly in 30g butter for 20 minutes. Score 8 franks and grill over coals until blistered. Toast 8 buns and fill with franks, onions, mustard and sweet relish.

w.n: Carnival fairy floss and toffee apples
w.note: the carnival where the rides go badly
w.how: Push sticks into 4 apples. Boil 400g sugar, 125ml water and 2 tbsp golden syrup to 150C, add red colouring and dip and twirl the apples. Set on oiled paper and serve with a bag of fairy floss.

d.note: a hot summer on the sandlot
d.how: Simmer 250g hulled strawberries with 150g caster sugar and 150ml water for 5 minutes, mash and strain, then cool the syrup. Squeeze 5 lemons. In a big jug mix the syrup, lemon juice and 1L cold soda water. Add lemon wheels, a few sliced strawberries and plenty of ice. Stir well and pour.
